topic: It is important to give bribes in order to get ahead in life

initialOpinions.text: I grew up in a family where we work hard in everything and we don't do and allow bribery. ALthough in some people and most cases it works well with them, but it is in our life's principle and values not do do such thing.

I disagree with the statement that it is important to give bribes in order to get ahead in life. Relying on bribery undermines fairness, encourages corruption, and creates an unequal society where merit and hard work are devalued. Success achieved through integrity is more sustainable and beneficial for both individuals and society as a whole.
